verdict.rationale: Multiple GitHub README claims explicitly describe 'Self-Hosting Freedom' and that Zero 'gives users the power to self-host their own email app,' framing it as an open-source, self-hostable product with a contributing/dev setup (Drizzle Studio, pnpm scripts). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a successful self-host deployment and detailed self-hosting setup docs beyond the roadmap mention.
